words: Round 123 DB-b-252 named the Cottonwood landing root's scheduler policy with the scheduler ROLE's name module, so aws_iam_role_policy.irpt_account_return_daily_scheduler carried the name irpt-cot-account-return-daily-scheduler-role on a policy; the naming-plan gate refused the applier's safe-apply on that address (rc 7, nothing written). This cell adds one opal_name module, irpt_account_return_daily_scheduler_policy_name (system irpt, scope from the same local as the role's module, function account-return-daily, kind policy, qualifier scheduler), and points only the scheduler policy's name attribute at it; the scheduler role keeps its own module and the execution pair is untouched. The naming gate in plan mode grades the six builder names of the root as CONFORMANT with no REFUSE on a synthetic plan. Not proven: no terraform plan, no apply, no AWS read or write; the real safe-apply, the live resource names and the re-bind of the signed pair are outside this cell.
